name: v27_earnings_news_credit_capacity
hypothesis: Earnings-news impact was strong but correlated with reversal/quality actives; replacing part of cashflow/reversal with credit capacity may preserve event signal while reducing common exposure.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((credit_facility_remaining_capacity - credit_facility_outstanding_balance) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
notes: Rescues d5xjLAWK/RRp7Ldae by lowering reversal and cashflow exposure; strict corr gate against 88zpWZ1X/MPpGzqwr.

name: v27_earnings_news_no_reversal_credit
hypothesis: If close-open reversal is the main correlation source, a no-reversal earnings-news + credit-capacity structure may be less crowded even if weaker.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((credit_facility_remaining_capacity - credit_facility_outstanding_balance) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
notes: No close/open, no operating_income/cashflow; compare strength to v14 no-reversal variant.

name: v27_competitor_hub_credit_news

expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ompetitorgraphrank_hub_rank, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
